# Full numbering override sequences

Original OOXML controls generated by `tools/numbering_override_sequence_fixture.py`
and `tools/numbering_override_nested_fixture.py`, using the original package shell
from the index controls. The generator reproduces every OPC part of both native
sources; it does not call the application serializer or another document engine.

`control.docx` has 72 paragraphs: consecutive items, references to invisible
ancestor counters, shared-instance sequences, starts omitted/present, absent
abstract starts and levels supplied only by an override. `nested.docx` has 60
paragraphs with full level-one overrides and intervening level-zero items.

The reference application rendered both sources to two-page PDFs. The reference-application opening helper
confirmed each exact file before automation. Binding the already-open path and
calling ExportAsFixedFormat(17) captured these references without modifying the
source. `tools/record_numbering_override_sequences.py --reference-build 16.0.20326`
recreates the references/images from those PDFs. Native row labels are extracted
from the PDFs; source/PDF/PNG SHA-256 values bind each observation. Additional
read-only ListValue queries for nested S05.2/S06.2/S07.2/S08.2 yielded 0/7/0/7,
confirming the hidden counter after an ancestor reset.

Observed reference semantics, beyond the simple starts described by ECMA-376 Part 1
17.9.8, 17.9.11, 17.9.25 and 17.9.26:

- A matching full override supplies formatting, but ordinary first entry uses the
  abstract level's start. Its own start (or zero if absent) governs resets caused
  by an ancestor. These must remain distinct values.
- An explicit startOverride activates the full child's start when that start is
  present; otherwise its own value is used. Consecutive items keep incrementing,
  including when aliases share an abstract definition.
- A conflicting child index supplies an empty replacement level. Its ignored
  child formatting/start do not leak into layout. Explicit startOverride remains
  active and invisible labels still advance counters.
- A deeper-level reference in a full override discards that override, including
  startOverride. This differs from a deeper reference in an abstract definition.

The importer models these observed compatibility rules without rewriting the
source parts. User-requested restart export must update an explicit child start,
or remove the ignored child when necessary for that edited level. Other source
nodes stay intact. Numerical index equivalence also applies during export so
zero-padded ilvl values do not create duplicate override records.

Tests cover native markers, original-byte parts, edit/reopen/undo/redo, ancestor
resets and restart serialization. See the browser tests for native full-page
painting comparisons and live editing. This is coverage of these controls, not
proof of every numbering format, layout combination, application version or template.
